tool_input.command:
S=/Users/dom/garden/scripts/jobs; P=/Users/dom/garden/.garden-state/producer/journal; REL=projects/garden/host-health/oros-studio-garden-ce242c49.md; F=$P/$REL; grep -n -A6 '23:24' $P/projects/garden/oros-health-log.md | cut -c1-500 | head -14; T=$(mktemp -d); cp $F $T/base; BLOB=$(git -C /tmp hash-object --no-filters $T/base 2>/dev/null || (cd $T && git hash-object --no-filters base))
python3 -I - "$T/base" "$T/new" <<'EOF'
import sys
s=open(sys.argv[1]).read()
a=s.index('## 2026-11-05T01:34:00Z'); b=s.index('## 2026-11-05T01:43Z'); c=s.index('## Record template')
old,mine=s[a:b],s[b:c]
mine=mine.replace('watch virtiofs free space (32G), not repaired or investigated here because of the roll.','the pack-growth observations named by the 01:34Z record stay unchecked (exited early for the roll); virtiofs has 32G free.')
open(sys.argv[2],'w').write(s[:a]+mine+old+s[c:])
EOF
grep -n '^## ' $T/new; timeout 300 $S/land-journal-edit.sh --base-blob "$BLOB" "$REL" $T/new 2>&1 | tail -2; echo rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; rm -rf $T
